firstLines: * Narrow adaptation of SDK v27.1.2 io_seproxyhal_io_heartbeat.
* (c) Ledger SAS, with Pearl review-session validation changes.
* The SDK's UI handlers are retained. A fault exits the app on nested requests,
* reported disconnect, lock or expiry. Browser-only abort is not a device event.
/* Only called while a trusted UI review is active. No private key is live. */
* Closed PSBTv2 profile: no ignored signing controls or host-selected network.
* Pearl adaptation of Ledger app-bitcoin. Experimental, not Ledger approved.
* These are application policy checks, not a consensus replay-protection domain.
